AI.method: 在InGaAsP/InP分布布拉格反射镜上外延低密度InAs/InP量子点，形成单片平面结构；通过仿真计算向上光提取效率，并用宽场光致发光成像实现量子点的质心定位，在脉冲准共振激发下进行原始峰面积积分评估单光子纯度与双光子干涉。
AI.result: 40 nm谱带内仿真向上提取效率超过10%；量子点质心定位精度约3 nm；1549.5 nm带电激子单光子纯度最高94.7%；未加工平面结构中顺序发射光子的原始双光子干涉可见度为2 ns窗口51%、4 ns窗口41%，且无Purcell增强。
AI.conclusion: 该架构将宽带光提取、高光子相干性与原生III-V晶圆上的发射体预选结合，为基于标记的确定性制备高品质单片纳米光子器件铺平道路。

title: Thermal expansion mechanisms, heat transport, and band-gap renormalization in strongly anharmonic Rb$_2$SO$_4$, Rb$_2$Ca$_2$(SO$_4$)$_3$, and Ba$_3$Lu(BO$_3$)$_3$ from machine-learned interatomic potentials
comment: 12 pages, 13 figures; Supplementary Material: 33 pages, 31 figures
summary: Rb$_2$SO$_4$, Rb$_2$Ca$_2$(SO$_4$)$_3$, and Ba$_3$Lu(BO$_3$)$_3$ are structurally complex materials whose thermal expansion has been interpreted, on the basis of high-temperature x-ray diffraction, in terms of specific polyhedral rearrangements. We study their lattice dynamics and its consequences for thermal and electronic properties using molecular dynamics with actively learned moment tensor potentials trained on density-functional theory data. The anharmonicity measure $σ^A$ (compares the anharmonic contribution to the interatomic forces with the total forces acting on atoms) reaches $\approx$0.3-0.5 for $β$-Rb$_2$SO$_4$, Rb$_2$Ca$_2$(SO$_4$)$_3$, and Ba$_3$Lu(BO$_3$)$_3$ and $\approx$0.75 for orientationally disordered $α$-Rb$_2$SO$_4$, and the imaginary harmonic modes of Rb$_2$Ca$_2$(SO$_4$)$_3$ and $α$-Rb$_2$SO$_4$ are stabilized at finite temperature. The simulations reproduce the measured thermal expansion and support the mechanisms proposed from diffraction: expansion along $c$ in $β$-Rb$_2$SO$_4$ arises from both elongation and straightening of corrugated Rb chains, BO$_3$ reorientation accompanies the anisotropic expansion of Ba$_3$Lu(BO$_3$)$_3$, and bending of polyhedral linkages limits expansion along the weakly expanding directions and in cubic Rb$_2$Ca$_2$(SO$_4$)$_3$. Green-Kubo lattice thermal conductivities differ by more than an order of magnitude between compounds with comparable $σ^A$, showing that the anharmonicity measure alone does not determine heat transport. Phonon-induced band-gap renormalization, including lattice thermal expansion, reaches 2.7 and 1.7 eV at 1250 K in Rb$_2$Ca$_2$(SO$_4$)$_3$ and Ba$_3$Lu(BO$_3$)$_3$ and 1.4 eV at 650 K in $β$-Rb$_2$SO$_4$, with zero-point renormalizations of 0.64, 0.70, and 0.31 eV for $β$-Rb$_2$SO$_4$, Rb$_2$Ca$_2$(SO$_4$)$_3$, and Ba$_3$Lu(BO$_3$)$_3$, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文用主动学习矩张量势的分子动力学模拟三种结构复杂材料(Rb2SO4、Rb2Ca2(SO4)3、Ba3Lu(BO3)3)的晶格动力学，验证其热膨胀机理、研究非谐性、热导率与声子诱导带隙重整化。
AI.motivation: 这三种材料的热膨胀此前仅由高温X射线衍射解释为特定的多面体重排，缺乏晶格动力学层面的直接证据；需要从原子尺度验证机理并考察非谐性对热学与电子性质的影响。
AI.method: 基于密度泛函理论数据，用主动学习训练矩张量势（MTP），再进行分子动力学模拟；计算非谐性度量σ^A、有限温度下的虚频模稳定性、热膨胀、格林-库伯（Green-Kubo）晶格热导率，以及含热膨胀的声子诱导带隙重整化。
AI.result: σ^A在β-Rb2SO4、Rb2Ca2(SO4)3、Ba3Lu(BO3)3中约0.3–0.5，取向无序α-Rb2SO4约0.75；Rb2Ca2(SO4)3与α-Rb2SO4的虚频模在有限温度下被稳定。模拟重现实测热膨胀并支持衍射提出的机理：β-Rb2SO4沿c轴膨胀源于褶皱Rb链的伸长与变直，Ba3Lu(BO3)3的各向异性膨胀伴随BO3重取向，多面体连接弯曲限制弱膨胀方向及立方Rb2Ca2(SO4)3的膨胀。σ^A相近的材料间热导率相差一个数量级以上，说明非谐性度量本身不决定热输运。带隙重整化：Rb2Ca2(SO4)3在1250K达2.7eV，Ba3Lu(BO3)3达1.7eV，β-Rb2SO4在650K达1.4eV；零点重整化分别为0.31、0.64、0.70eV。
AI.conclusion: 机器学习势的分子动力学可准确重现复杂材料热膨胀并验证衍射推断的机理；非谐性强度不足以预测热导率；声子诱导（含热膨胀）的带隙重整化在高温下十分显著。

title: Learning Cole-Hopf Coordinates for Stochastic Growth Dynamics: the KPZ class
summary:
Inferring effective equations from observations of nonlinear stochastic processes is challenging because individual trajectories are noisy realizations, while the relevant physical information is encoded in ensemble statistics. We introduce a data-driven framework that learns a change of variables in which nonlinear stochastic dynamics become linear. The model combines a neural change of representation with a linear stochastic latent evolution and is trained through a short-time moment-matching objective, thereby avoiding trajectory \rev{simulation} during optimization. This construction yields an interpretable generative model: both the learned transformation and the latent evolution operators can be directly inspected.
  We validate the method on the one-dimensional Kardar--Parisi--Zhang (KPZ) equation, a paradigmatic model of stochastic growth for which the Cole--Hopf transformation maps the nonlinear dynamics to the stochastic heat equation. From simulated height trajectories alone, the model recovers the local exponential Cole--Hopf map and the associated linear stochastic operator. Generated trajectories reproduce the main statistical signatures of the KPZ universality class, including the growth law $\mathrm{Var}(h^{t})\sim t^{2β}$ with $β=1/3$ and the GOE Tracy--Widom height distribution for flat initial conditions. These results show that interpretable stochastic equations can be inferred from data by learning representations in which the dynamics closes in a simple form. Furthermore the development of the physical informed learning permits to get insights on the physics of the dynamical process.

AI.tldr: 提出数据驱动的非线性随机动力学"线性化"框架：用神经网络学习变量变换，使非线性随机动力学在潜空间变为线性随机演化，通过短时矩匹配目标训练（无需轨迹模拟），在1D KPZ方程上成功恢复Cole–Hopf变换与线性算子，并重现KPZ普适类的统计特征。
AI.motivation: 从观测数据推断非线性随机过程的有效方程很困难：单条轨迹是高噪声实现，物理信息藏在系综统计中；同时希望推断结果可解释（如恢复已知的可积变换），而非纯黑箱。
AI.method: 神经网络学习变量变换 + 潜空间线性随机演化（线性随机算子）的组合模型；以短时间矩匹配（moment matching）为训练目标，避免优化中做轨迹模拟；变换与潜演化算子均可直接检视。
AI.result: 在1D KPZ方程（Cole–Hopf可解，对应随机热方程）上验证：仅用模拟高度轨迹，模型恢复出局部指数型Cole–Hopf映射及相应线性随机算子；生成轨迹重现KPZ普适类特征——方差增长 Var(h)~t^{2β}, β=1/3，以及平板初始条件下的GOE Tracy–Widom高度分布。
AI.conclusion: 通过学习使动力学以简单形式闭合的表征，可从数据推断可解释的随机方程；该物理知情学习方式还能为动力过程的物理机制提供洞见。

title: Piezo-Kerr effect in altermagnets and noncollinear antiferromagnets
summary: Symmetry is usually viewed as a constraint on physical responses, but it can also be used to design the fields that control them. Here, we adopt the representation-matching principle used to identify conjugate fields of order parameters and apply it to response tensors. A linear coupling, the key ingredient for sign-switching control, is symmetry-allowed when a component (or a combination of components) of the control field and the selected response component share the same irreducible representation of the magnetic point group (MPG) of the system. Applied to the magneto-optical Kerr effect, this principle yields a piezo-Kerr effect, in which specific strain combinations activate a Kerr response forbidden in the unstrained state. Enumerating all 122 MPGs, we identify 16 groups in which the unstrained Kerr response is forbidden while a linear strain-induced contribution is allowed. These groups are realized by altermagnets and noncollinear antiferromagnets with symmetry-enforced vanishing net magnetization. The active strain channels and the associated first-order sign reversals follow directly from symmetry. First-principles calculations for bulk MnTe$_{2}$ and CoF$_{2}$, and Cr$_{2}$Se$_{2}$O and Cr$_{2}$Te$_{2}$O monolayers confirm these predictions. In these materials, the Kerr rotation vanishes without strain, whereas 0.5-3% strain produces rotations ranging from tens to hundreds of millidegrees, and reversing the matched strain channel reverses the Kerr sign. These results establish a general route to large and switchable Kerr responses emerging from symmetry-forbidden states in compensated magnets.

AI.tldr: 通过对称性表示匹配原则设计应变控制场，发现"压电-克尔效应"：16个磁点群中无应变克尔响应被禁戒，但线性应变诱导贡献被允许，并在MnTe₂、CoF₂及Cr₂Se₂O/Cr₂Te₂O单层中获第一性原理验证。
AI.motivation: 对称性通常被视为对物理响应的约束，但也可反过来用于设计控制响应的外场。作者希望找到一种通用方法，使原本被对称性禁戒的磁光响应（如克尔效应）可通过线性耦合被"激活"并可翻转符号。
AI.method: 采用用于识别序参量共轭场的"表示匹配原则"，将其推广到响应张量：当控制场某分量（或其组合）与所选中响应分量具有系统磁点群（MPG）的相同不可约表示时，线性耦合被对称性允许。对全部122个MPG进行枚举，并配合第一性原理计算在具体材料中验证。
AI.result: 在122个MPG中识别出16个群：无应变时克尔响应被禁戒，而线性应变诱导贡献被允许。这些群由交错磁体及净磁化被对称性强制为零的非共线反铁磁体实现。应变通道与一阶符号反转直接由对称性给出。对块体MnTe₂、CoF₂及Cr₂Se₂O、Cr₂Te₂O单层的第一性原理计算证实：无应变时克尔旋转为零，0.5–3%应变产生数十至数百毫度旋转，反向匹配应变通道即反转克尔符号。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了一条从对称性禁戒态出发、在补偿磁体中获得大且可切换克尔响应的通用路径，压电-克尔效应为应变调控磁光器件提供了设计准则。

title: Chiroptical Valleytronic in SnSe
summary: Quantum geometric properties of Bloch electrons play a central role in governing light-matter interactions and transport phenomena in solids. Here, we report quantum-geometric chiroptical selection rules that generate a helicity-dependent momentum-space population imbalance in the group-IV monochalcogenide SnSe. By combining time- and angle-resolved extreme-ultraviolet photoemission spectroscopy with ab initio real-time simulations of photoexcited carrier dynamics, we identify valley-selective excitation at opposite crystal momenta arising from the breaking of time-reversal symmetry under circularly polarized illumination. We theoretically demonstrate that the magnitude of valley circular dichroism is strongly constrained by crystal symmetry through its influence on the quantum geometric tensor, the key quantity underlying valley optical selection rules. The resulting chiroptically induced valley polarization decays on sub-picosecond timescales through intervalley scattering mediated by electron-phonon coupling. Furthermore, we show theoretically that the population imbalance between valleys at opposite momenta gives rise to a helicity-reversible transient photocurrent. These findings provide microscopic insight into how quantum geometry governs valley-selective light-matter interactions, valley polarization, and photocurrent generation in van der Waals materials exhibiting hidden and transient symmetry breaking.

AI.tldr: 本文利用时间/角分辨极紫外光电子能谱（tr-ARPES）与实时从头算模拟，在SnSe中观测并解释由量子几何决定的手性光学选择定则所诱导的动量空间谷极化及其超快衰减与光电流生成。
AI.motivation: Bloch电子的量子几何性质主导固体内光-物质相互作用与输运，但其如何具体控制手性（螺旋性依赖）光选择定则、谷极化的产生与退相干，以及瞬态光电流，尚缺乏微观层面的实验与理论对应。
AI.method: 对IV族单硫族化合物SnSe：①用时间与角分辨极紫外光电子能谱测量圆偏振光激发下载流子的动量空间分布；②结合从头算实时光激发载流子动力学模拟；③以量子几何张量分析晶体对称性对谷圆二色性大小的约束；④模拟谷间电子-声子散射与瞬态光电流。
AI.result: 在圆偏振光下时间反演对称性破缺，出现相反晶体动量处的谷选择性激发（谷圆二色性），其幅度受晶体对称性通过量子几何张量的强烈约束；谷极化在亚皮秒时间尺度经电子-声子耦合的谷间散射衰减；相反动量谷间布居不平衡在理论上产生可随螺旋性翻转的瞬态光电流。
AI.conclusion: 研究给出了量子几何如何主导谷选择性光-物质相互作用、谷极化动力学与光电流生成的微观图像，适用于具有隐藏/瞬态对称性破缺的范德华材料。

title: Active phase separation from concentration-dependent diffusion in chemical networks
summary: Active phase separation in living systems is ubiquitous, yet the microscopic origins of the non-equilibrium terms in active field theories remain largely unknown. Here, starting from stochastic mass-conserving reaction-diffusion dynamics of two interacting chemical species, we perform a systematic slow-mode reduction and derive the complete Active Model B+ field theory, with all phenomenological coefficients expressed in terms of microscopic parameters. We identify concentration-dependent diffusivities and asymmetric inter-species chemotactic couplings as the minimal microscopic ingredients generating the genuinely non-equilibrium coefficient responsible for microphase separation, cluster phases, and arrested coarsening. Our framework recovers the equilibrium limit consistently and is validated by stochastic numerical simulations. These results establish a direct, bottom-up link between the architecture of chemical reaction networks and the universality class of their emergent large-scale dynamics.

AI.tldr: 从守恒型双组分反应-扩散微观动力学出发，通过慢模约简严格推导出完整的 Active Model B+ 场论，并把所有唯象系数用微观参数表出。
AI.motivation: 活性场论中非平衡项（如 Active Model B+ 的 \|∇φ\|² 项）的微观起源尚不清楚，缺乏从化学反应网络到宏观普适类的自下而上桥梁。
AI.method: 对两种相互作用化学物种的随机质量守恒反应-扩散动力学做系统性慢模约简，推导出完整的 Active Model B+ 场论，并以随机数值模拟验证，同时检验平衡极限的还原性。
AI.result: 识别出浓度依赖扩散系数与不对称种间趋化耦合是产生真正非平衡系数的最小微观要素，该系数导致微相分离、团簇相与粗化停滞；推导结果与随机模拟一致，并正确恢复平衡极限。
AI.conclusion: 建立了化学反应网络结构与涌现大尺度动力学普适类之间的直接、自下而上的联系。

title: Intensity-driven Mott-like transition in a 2D Ruddlesden-Popper perovskite
summary: Two-dimensional Ruddlesden-Popper-type halide perovskites have emerged as promising cutting-edge nonlinear optical materials due to their strong excitonic effects and carrier-density-dependent optical responses. In this work, we investigate the nonlinear optical properties and ultrafast carrier dynamics of (BA)$_2$PbI$_4$ under infrared excitation, resonant with the two-photon energy of its excitonic transition. Using a nonlinear femtosecond Z-scan measurement with a 1030\,nm pump pulse, we observe a pronounced intensity-dependent evolution of the nonlinear absorption coefficient and the refractive index. With increasing pump intensity, a switch from saturable absorption to reverse saturable absorption emerges, suggesting an intensity-driven Mott-like transition. To elucidate the underlying carrier dynamics, intensity-dependent transient absorption spectroscopy was performed under the same excitation intensities. This reveals a long-lived charge carrier population above the estimated Mott density, reflecting a clear phase transition from an exciton-dominated regime to a dense electron-hole plasma regime. Moreover, such an intensity-driven, high, and switchable nonlinear optical response, along with a Mott-like transition under infrared pulse excitation, makes the 2D (BA)$_2$PbI$_4$ perovskites suitable for all-optical operation in the infrared regime.

AI.tldr: 研究二维(BA)2PbI4钙钛矿在1030nm红外飞秒激发下的非线性光学响应与超快载流子动力学，发现随泵浦强度增加出现从饱和吸收到反饱和吸收的切换，归因于类Mott相变（激子主导→高密度电子-空穴等离子体），适用于红外全光操作。
AI.motivation: 二维Ruddlesden-Popper型卤化物钙钛矿因强激子效应和载流子密度依赖的光学响应被视为有前景的非线性光学材料，但其在红外激发（双光子共振）下的非线性吸收与超快载流子动力学机制尚需阐明。
AI.method: 采用1030nm泵浦的飞秒非线性Z扫描测量非线性吸收系数与折射率的强度依赖性；并在相同激发强度下进行强度依赖的瞬态吸收光谱，以揭示载流子动力学与Mott密度判据。
AI.result: 观察到非线性吸收与折射率随强度显著演化，随泵浦强度增加出现饱和吸收向反饱和吸收的切换；瞬态吸收显示超过估计Mott密度的长寿命载流子布居，表明从激子主导向致密电子-空穴等离子体的相变。
AI.conclusion: (BA)2PbI4二维钙钛矿具有强度驱动、高且可切换的非线性光学响应及红外脉冲下的类Mott相变，适合红外波段全光操作应用。

title: Donor-acceptor recombination in diamond
summary: We re-examine several optical systems that have previously been attributed to donor-acceptor (D-A) recombination in diamond, including the broad 2.8 eV and 2.3 eV bands, and the sharp-lined series in the ranges 2.0-2.7 eV and 4.0-5.0 eV. In all cases, internal transitions at one or multiple defect centers provide a more consistent explanation of the experimental observations than the D-A model. The 2.3 eV case is marginal, where the key argument against the D-A recombination is the improbably low probability of tunneling between remote donors and acceptors in diamonds with very low concentrations of impurities (~0.1 ppm). A more realistic model for the 2.3 eV band and the associated phosphorescence and thermoluminescence phenomena is trapping of electrons and holes at nitrogen and boron defects, respectively, followed by recombination at a deep center, which is tentatively assigned to the nearest neighbor B-N pair.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了金刚石中先前被归因于施主-受主（D-A）复合的若干光学体系（2.8 eV、2.3 eV 宽带，以及 2.0–2.7 eV 和 4.0–5.0 eV 的锐线系列），认为单个或多个缺陷中心的内部跃迁比 D-A 模型更符合实验。
AI.motivation: 以往文献将金刚石中多个光学谱带（尤其 2.8 eV、2.3 eV 宽带及锐线系列）解释为施主-受主复合发光，但该模型在低杂质浓度下存在物理合理性疑问，作者希望检验并替代这一解释。
AI.method: 通过重新分析已有光学实验数据（吸收/发光谱带、锐线系列），逐一对比 D-A 复合模型与"缺陷中心内部跃迁"模型的解释能力；对 2.3 eV 带，评估极低杂质浓度（约 0.1 ppm）下远距离施主-受主隧穿几率的合理性，并提出电子与空穴分别被氮、硼缺陷俘获后于深中心（暂定为最近邻 B-N 对）复合的模型来解释该带及伴随的磷光和热释光现象。
AI.result: 在所有考察情形中，一个或多个缺陷中心的内部跃迁均能比 D-A 模型更一致地解释实验观测；2.3 eV 情形处于临界状态，反对 D-A 的关键论据是在约 0.1 ppm 极低杂质浓度下远距离施主-受主隧穿概率低得不合实际。
AI.conclusion: 金刚石中这些光学体系不应归因于 D-A 复合，而应归于缺陷中心内部跃迁；2.3 eV 带及伴随的磷光与热释光更宜用氮、硼缺陷分别俘获电子与空穴、继而在深中心（暂定最近邻 B-N 对）复合的机制描述。

title: Role of Chalcogen-p States in the Optical Response of Bulk PtSe2 and PtTe2
summary: The type-II Dirac semimetals PtSe$_2$ and PtTe$_2$ are isostructural and isovalent layered compounds but exhibit distinct electronic properties. We measure the in-plane infrared reflectivity of bulk crystals between 10 and 300 K and compare the interband contribution to the optical conductivity with band-resolved density-functional calculations. At low temperature, the Drude spectral weight of PtTe$_2$ is an order of magnitude larger than that of PtSe$_2$. PtTe$_2$ also shows a broad mid-infrared absorption continuum, whereas the absorption of PtSe$_2$ remains weak. The calculations attribute this continuum to transitions from a predominantly chalcogen-$p$ band into a Pt-$d$ band. In PtTe$_2$, the chalcogen-$p$ band lies higher in energy, which lowers the onset of these transitions and increases the semimetallic band overlap, in line with the larger Drude spectral weight. The type-II Dirac points lie far below the Fermi level, so that transitions between the bands forming the Dirac cones do not contribute appreciably to the interband conductivity.

AI.tldr: 等构等价的层状II型狄拉克半金属PtSe2与PtTe2电子性质差异显著；红外反射率测量与能带计算表明PtTe2的Drude谱重比PtSe2大一个数量级，且存在中红外吸收连续谱，源于硫族p带到Pt-d带的跃迁；PtTe2中p带位置更高导致跃迁起始能量降低、半金属能带重叠增大，与更大Drude谱重一致；II型狄拉克点远低于费米能级，对带间电导贡献甚微。
AI.motivation: PtSe2和PtTe2虽同构同价却电子性质不同，需澄清其光学响应差异的微观起源，特别是II型狄拉克点及能带结构对光导的贡献。
AI.method: 在10–300 K测量块体单晶的面内红外反射率，提取光导的带间贡献，并与按能带分辨的密度泛函计算结果对比。
AI.result: 低温下PtTe2的Drude谱重比PtSe2大约一个数量级；PtTe2出现宽的中红外吸收连续谱而PtSe2吸收较弱；计算将连续谱归因于主要来自硫族p带到Pt-d带的跃迁；PtTe2中硫族p带能量更高，降低跃迁起始能并增大半金属能带重叠，与更大Drude谱重相符。
AI.conclusion: 两种化合物的光学差异主要源于硫族p带相对位置引起的带间跃迁起始能与能带重叠差异；II型狄拉克点远离费米能级，形成狄拉克锥的能带间跃迁对带间电导无显著贡献。

title: Contact Renormalization of One-Mode Electron Correlation: Validation in Four- and Ten-Electron Systems
summary: A stationary many-electron eigenstate has one dynamical phase although its internal response can be strongly multimode. We ask whether the stationary Hartree--Fock information carrier contains enough information to determine the scalar correlation energy through one effective return. In regularized Hartree--Fock, Gaussian primitive products fix a minimum-information relative-coordinate mode before any one-mode reduction; virial completion defines the correlation source, while exact contact measures the additional return restriction created by neighboring occupied pairs. The Be-like $1s^22s^2$ sequence establishes the one-valence-pair boundary: with no neighboring occupied valence pair, the source returns through the universal floor $D_0=\sqrt{1+δ^2}$. Ten-electron molecules and Ne-like ions then test how finite-pair contact dresses that return. The same parameter-free source--return construction reproduces the established molecular and ionic correlation trends with quantitative accuracy. The numerical agreement therefore serves as validation of a physical separation between source strength and return restriction, rather than as the objective by itself.

AI.tldr: 提出一种"源—返回"(source–return)参数自由的构造，用Hartree–Fock信息载体通过一次有效返回来确定标量相关能，并在Be-like、十电子分子及Ne-like离子序列上验证其定量准确性。
AI.motivation: 平稳多电子本征态虽内部响应高度多模，却只有一个动力学相位。作者追问：平稳的Hartree–Fock信息载体是否包含足够信息，通过一次有效返回来确定标量相关能。
AI.method: 在正则化Hartree–Fock中，用高斯原函数乘积在任何单模约化之前固定一个最小信息相对坐标模式；用virial完成定义相关源；用精确接触(exact contact)度量相邻占据对产生的额外返回限制。以Be-like 1s²2s²序列确定单一价对边界（无相邻占据价对时源经普适下限D₀=√(1+δ²)返回），再在十电子分子和Ne-like离子上考察有限对接触如何修饰该返回。
AI.result: 同一套参数自由的源—返回构造定量再现了已确立的分子与离子相关能趋势，达到定量精度。
AI.conclusion: 数值吻合被视为对"源强度与返回限制之间存在物理分离"这一图像的支持与验证，而非研究目标本身。

title: Nitrogen vacancy cluster-mediated ferroelectric domain growth in wurtzite AlN
summary: Aluminum nitride-based ferroelectrics combine high remanent polarization, thermal stability, weak size effects, a wide bandgap and back-end process compatibility, making them promising for high density non-volatile memory. However, their high coercive field ($E_\mathrm{c}$) and unclear polarization switching mechanism limit further applications. Theoretical predictions indicate preferential reversed domain growth along the polar axis, whereas experiments show nearly isotropic growth or preferential growth perpendicular to this axis. Here, we combine density functional theory, Deep Potential molecular dynamics and experimental characterization to determine how nitrogen vacancies ($V_\mathrm{N}$) regulate domain growth and $E_\mathrm{c}$. In ideal crystal, strong lattice coupling along the polar axis drives preferential domain growth in this direction. $V_\mathrm{N}$ locally weakens this coupling and promotes polarization nucleation. The spatial distribution of $V_\mathrm{N}$ and the temporal sequence of vacancy induced switching jointly determine the direction and morphology of reversed domain growth. We further show that scandium doping promotes $V_\mathrm{N}$ formation, thereby enhancing defect mediated nucleation and reducing $E_\mathrm{c}$. These findings establish a multiscale mechanism governing thin-film domain-growth kinetics and macroscopic $E_\mathrm{c}$, reconciling experimental observations with ideal crystal simulations and providing defect engineering principles for low-voltage, reliable and scalable ferroelectric devices.

AI.tldr: 该文结合DFT、Deep Potential分子动力学与实验，揭示氮空位(V_N)如何调控AlN基铁电体的畴生长与矫顽场E_c，并证明Sc掺杂通过促进V_N形成降低E_c。
AI.motivation: AlN基铁电体具备高剩余极化、热稳定性、弱尺寸效应、宽禁带及后道工艺兼容性，适合高密度非易失存储；但其高矫顽场E_c和不清的极化翻转机制阻碍应用。理论预测反向畴沿极性轴择优生长，而实验观察到近各向同性或垂直于极性轴生长，二者矛盾需解释。
AI.method: 采用密度泛函理论(DFT)、Deep Potential分子动力学与实验表征相结合的多尺度方法，系统研究氮空位对畴生长动力学和E_c的影响，并分析Sc掺杂对V_N形成的作用。
AI.result: 理想晶体中沿极性轴的强晶格耦合驱动畴沿该方向择优生长；V_N局部削弱该耦合并促进极化成核。V_N的空间分布与空位诱导翻转的时间序列共同决定反向畴生长的方向与形貌。Sc掺杂促进V_N形成，增强缺陷介导成核从而降低E_c。
AI.conclusion: 建立了支配薄膜畴生长动力学与宏观E_c的多尺度机制，调和了实验观测与理想晶体模拟之间的矛盾，并为低电压、高可靠、可扩展铁电器件提供缺陷工程原则。

title: The often overlooked role of sound in liquid thermal transport
summary: Formulated a hundred years ago, the Bridgman formula for thermal conductivity of liquids postulates a proportionality between sound velocity and thermal conductivity. This designates phonons as heat carriers in a liquid. Its empirical success has been under-appreciated and its conceptual implications overlooked. It is not mentioned in well-known condensed-matter textbook. Here, we review its origin, its links to hydrodynamic Euler equations and to the fundamental paradox surrounding the parabolic heat equation and its fate across the quantum-classical crossover.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视百年前提出的Bridgman液体热导率公式（声速与热导率成正比），梳理其起源、与流体力学欧拉方程的联系，以及围绕抛物型热方程的悖论，并讨论其在量子-经典过渡中的命运。
AI.motivation: Bridgman公式虽经验上成功，但长期未被充分认识，其概念含义（声子作为液体中热载流子）被忽视，甚至未见于主流凝聚态教科书中，作者希望纠正这一被低估的状况。
AI.method: 采用综述/理论分析方式：追溯Bridgman公式的历史来源，将其与流体动力学欧拉方程建立联系，并分析其与抛物型热传导方程根本悖论的关系，考察其跨越量子-经典过渡的行为。
AI.result: 此类文章的原文未给出新实验数据或定量结果；论文属概念性综述，主要是揭示Bridgman公式的理论关联与物理含义。
AI.conclusion: Bridgman公式不只是经验规律，而是指向液体中声子传热的重要物理图像，与流体力学和热传导基础悖论密切相关，值得在凝聚态物理教学中重新重视。

title: Interaction-enhanced antiferromagnetic correlations in a Kondo ladder with a gapped band structure
summary: We investigate magnetic correlations in the two-leg Kondo-Hubbard ladder using the density-matrix renormalization group method. We focus on a parameter regime in which the noninteracting electronic system has a narrow indirect band gap. In this regime, there is no Fermi surface, and the conventional Fermi-surface-based Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida picture is not directly applicable; magnetic correlations between localized spins become weaker as the noninteracting band gap increases. We find that a moderate on-site Coulomb interaction enhances the antiferromagnetic correlations between localized spins. This enhancement, which is also seen in the staggered magnetization induced by a pinning field at the edges, occurs for both ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic Kondo couplings. Our results show that electron-electron interactions can enhance magnetic correlations between localized spins even when the underlying noninteracting electronic structure is gapped, suggesting an interaction-driven route to magnetic instabilities in narrow-gap Kondo-lattice systems.

AI.tldr: 用DMRG研究两腿Kondo-Hubbard梯子在窄间接带隙区，发现适度在位库仑相互作用可增强局域自旋间的反铁磁关联，即便无费米面。
AI.motivation: 在无能隙费米面的窄带隙体系中，传统基于费米面的RKKY图像不适用，局域自旋磁关联随带隙增大而减弱，需探究电子-电子相互作用能否在此情形下驱动磁关联。
AI.method: 采用密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）方法，研究两腿Kondo-Hubbard梯子中非相互作用电子具有窄间接带隙的参数区间，考察在位库仑作用U对局域自旋磁关联的影响，并用边缘钉扎场诱导的交错磁化加以检验。
AI.result: 适度在位库仑相互作用增强了局域自旋间的反铁磁关联；该增强在铁磁与反铁磁Kondo耦合下均出现，且在边缘钉扎场诱导的交错磁化中也可见。
AI.conclusion: 即使底层非相互作用电子结构带隙存在、无费米面，电子-电子相互作用仍能增强局域自旋磁关联，提示窄带隙Kondo晶格体系中存在由相互作用驱动的磁不稳定性路径。

title: Tracking the Emergence and Persistence of Abnormal Grain Growth in an Aluminum Alloy using Diffraction-Contrast Tomography
summary: Abnormal grain growth is inherently three-dimensional, making 3D tracking of grain evolution essential for understanding its underlying mechanisms. This study combines synchrotron-based diffraction-contrast tomography and phase-contrast tomography to characterize the three-dimensional grain structure and quantify the size and spatial distribution of second-phase particles in the aluminum alloy AA5252. Using an interrupted annealing protocol, we tracked the persistent growth of abnormal grains and the emergence of abnormal growth in a grain initially belonging to the matrix. Although second-phase particles effectively suppressed grain growth in the matrix, variations in local particle density showed no apparent correlation with either the emergence or subsequent rapid growth of abnormal grains. Instead, crystallographic misorientation and, more notably, neighboring grain size were identified as stronger predictors of abnormal growth rate. Matrix grains were consumed more rapidly when they were relatively small and shared high-angle grain boundaries with the growing abnormal grain. The same trends were observed for the grain that underwent a transition from normal to abnormal growth. Remarkably, even before the onset of abnormal growth, this grain was surrounded by smaller matrix grains with exclusively high-angle grain boundaries, while the local particle density was slightly higher than average. These findings suggest that the same microstructural characteristics facilitate both the emergence and persistence of abnormal grain growth, although the mechanism triggering the transition to rapid growth remains unresolved.

AI.tldr: 结合同步辐射衍射衬度CT与相位衬度CT，对AA5252铝合金晶粒进行三维追踪，发现异常晶粒的生长与持续并不由第二相粒子密度决定，而晶界取向差和相邻晶粒尺寸是更强预测因子。
AI.motivation: 异常晶粒长大本质上是三维过程，因此需要三维晶粒演化追踪才能理解其机制；本文旨在厘清第二相粒子、取向差与邻晶尺寸等因素对异常长大的作用。
AI.method: 采用同步辐射衍射衬度层析（DCT）与相位衬度层析（PCT）表征AA5252铝合金的三维晶粒结构，并量化第二相粒子尺寸与空间分布；通过中断退火（interrupted annealing）方案对异常晶粒的持续长大及一个原属基体晶粒向异常长大的转变进行追踪。
AI.result: 第二相粒子有效抑制了基体中的晶粒长大，但局部粒子密度与异常晶粒的出现及后续快速长大无明显相关性；晶界取向差尤其邻晶尺寸是异常长大速率的更强预测因子——当基体晶粒较小且与生长中的异常晶粒共享大角度晶界时被更快消耗；由正常转变为异常长大的晶粒趋势相同，且在转变前即被较小、全为大角度晶界的基体晶粒包围，局部粒子密度仅略高于平均。
AI.conclusion: 相同的微观结构特征同时促进异常晶粒长大的出现与持续，但触发向快速长大转变的机制仍未被解析。

title: Anomalous polar chains in halide perovskites
summary: Local polar distortions, their collective ordering, and their field-driven reversal have been studied extensively in ferroelectric perovskites for decades. Here we identify an unusual behavior in the ferroelectric halide perovskite CsGeBr3 using large-scale molecular dynamics with first-principles-trained interatomic potentials. In its nominally cubic phase the Ge off-centering forms one-dimensional polar chains that extend over at least tens of nanometers and relax on nanosecond timescales, four orders of magnitude slower than in BaTiO3 and PbTiO3, with CsSnBr3 in between. The cubic CsGeBr3 phase is a dynamically disordered state in which oppositely polarized chains flip throughout the crystal, and a long-lived one-dimensional local polarization coexists with zero net polarization. A simple three-dimensional perovskite thus hosts long-ranged one-dimensional polar correlations with remarkably slow dynamics. In the ferroelectric phase the same chains set a one-dimensional switching mechanism, in which the polarization reverses chain by chain.

AI.tldr: CsGeBr3立方相中存在长达数十纳米、纳秒尺度弛豫的一维极性链，表现为长寿命一维局域极化与零净极化共存；铁电相中极化以逐链方式反转。
AI.motivation: 钙钛矿铁电体中局域极性畸变及其集体有序与场致反转已被广泛研究，但作者希望探究卤化物钙钛矿CsGeBr3中是否存在不同寻常的极性行为。
AI.method: 采用基于第一性原理训练原子间势的大规模分子动力学模拟。
AI.result: 名义立方相的CsGeBr3中Ge偏心形成延伸至少数十纳米的一维极性链，弛豫时间达纳秒量级，比BaTiO3和PbTiO3慢四个数量级，CsSnBr3介于两者之间；立方相是动态无序态，反向极化的链在全晶体中翻转，长寿命一维局域极化与零净极化共存；铁电相中同样的一维链决定逐链反转的开关机制。
AI.conclusion: 一个简单三维钙钛矿即可承载具有极慢动力学的长程一维极性关联，并给出一维逐链极化反转机制。

title: Site and bond percolation thresholds of all $k$-uniform tilings with $k\le 10$
comment: 19 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Code, data and raw histograms: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23533708
summary: We determine the site and bond percolation thresholds of all 23,396 $k$-uniform tilings of the plane by regular polygons with $k\le 10$, the complete set according to the known enumeration. We use Monte Carlo simulation on tori and the condition that no wrapping and a cross-wrapping cluster are equally probable, the Monte Carlo form of the critical-polynomial criterion, which needs no knowledge of the large-scale anisotropy that most of these lattices have. The 486 thresholds with $k\le4$ have uncertainties of a few units in the sixth decimal and reproduce the 22 Archimedean reference values (rms deviation 0.71 standard errors) and unpublished bond thresholds of the 20 two-uniform lattices ($χ^2=19.5$ for 20 values); the others have median statistical uncertainties of $2\times10^{-5}$ ($k\le7$) to $7\times10^{-5}$ ($k\ge8$) and no detectable finite-size bias. The vertex-type fractions alone fix the thresholds for $k\ge5$ to about $2\times10^{-3}$ (linear rule fitted on $k\le4$), while tilings with equal composition differ by up to $6\times10^{-3}$ (site) and $2\times10^{-2}$ (bond). In the range of domain sizes covered, descriptors of radius one account for more than half of this difference, and stackings of identical strips have thresholds linear in the fraction of each boundary type. For tilings that differ only by the registry of strips separated by $h$ rows of squares, the bond threshold difference decreases by a factor of 6-8 per row, comparable to the leading momentum-$π$ eigenvalue of the square-band transfer matrix.

AI.tldr: 本文用蒙特卡洛方法确定了全部23,396种k≤10的k-均匀平铺（平面规则多边形镶嵌）的格点与键渗流阈值，并分析其与几何描述符的关系。
AI.motivation: 大量均匀平铺晶格缺乏渗流阈值数据，尤其非阿基米德型（多均匀）晶格具有复杂的各向异性，传统临界多项式判据需知道大尺度各向异性，难以直接应用。
AI.method: 在环面上做蒙特卡洛模拟，采用"无环绕簇与交叉环绕簇等概率"的条件（临界多项式的蒙特卡洛形式，无需知道大尺度各向异性）；对k≤4的486个阈值检验与参考值的吻合及有限尺寸偏差；并用顶点类型分数、半径一描述符、条带堆叠等几何特征回归分析阈值差异。
AI.result: k≤4的486个阈值不确定度为第六位小数几个单位，复现22个阿基米德参考值（rms偏差0.71标准误）及20个双均匀晶格的未发表键阈值（χ²=19.5）；其余中位统计不确定度2×10⁻⁵(k≤7)至7×10⁻⁵(k≥8)，无可测有限尺寸偏差。仅顶点类型分数可将k≥5阈值定到约2×10⁻³；等组成平铺间差异可达6×10⁻³（格点）与2×10⁻²（键），半径一描述符解释过半差异；相同条带堆叠阈值随边界类型分数线性变化；以h行方格分隔的条带配准差异使键阈值差异每行衰减6-8倍，与方带转移矩阵的主导动量-π本征值相当。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可高精度、无偏地计算复杂各向异性镶嵌的渗流阈值，形成大规模数据集；阈值主要由局部几何（顶点类型、半径一描述符、条带边界）决定，且条带配准效应可用转移矩阵本征值定量刻画。

title: Mn-deficient Ni-Mn-Ga alloys: phase transitions, magnetic properties, and disappearance of martensitic transformation
summary: Composition gradients formed during directional solidification are generally considered undesirable in Ni-Mn-Ga magnetic shape-memory alloys. However, these gradients offer a highly effective platform for systematically investigating composition-property relationships under identical growth and heat-treatment conditions. To exploit this approach, one Mn-deficient and two near-stoichiometric Ni-Mn-Ga oligocrystals were grown by optical zone remelting and characterized by X-ray fluorescence mapping, optical microscopy, X-ray diffraction, low-field magnetic measurements, and vibrating-sample magnetometry. The ingots contained elongated grains and axial compositional gradients, primarily associated with the redistribution of Mn and Ga, whereas Ni remained relatively uniformly distributed. The martensitic and premartensitic transformation temperatures generally increased with increasing Mn content. Neither transformation was detected between 10 and 400 K in specimens containing 20.5-22.0 at.% Mn, all of which had $e/a < 7.40$. In contrast, both transformations were observed in the investigated specimens containing at least 22.1 at.% ($e/a \geq 7.46$). This abrupt change may indicate a possible electron-concentration threshold for the occurrence of these transformations. Saturation magnetization increased with Mn content up to 25.8 at.%, reaching 96.9 A m$^2$/kg at 10 K and 71.2 A m$^2$/kg at 300 K. Post-growth annealing increased the transition temperatures and changed the low-field magnetic response. The results indicate that composition-gradient oligocrystals serve as an effective platform for investigating the relationships between composition, structure, and magnetic properties in Ni-Mn-Ga alloys with the same processing history.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用定向凝固形成的成分梯度Ni-Mn-Ga寡晶，在相同生长与热处理条件下系统研究成分-性能关系，发现Mn含量（电子浓度）存在约22.1 at.%（e/a≈7.46）的马氏体/预马氏体相变阈值，并揭示磁化强度随Mn含量的变化规律。
AI.motivation: Ni-Mn-Ga定向凝固产生的成分梯度通常被视为不利缺陷，但作者将其转化为优势：在同一生长与热处理历史下，可系统研究成分对结构与磁性能的影响，避免不同样品间工艺差异带来的干扰。
AI.method: 采用光学区熔法制备一根缺Mn和两根近化学计量比的Ni-Mn-Ga寡晶；通过X射线荧光映射、光学显微镜、X射线衍射、低场磁测量和振动样品磁强计进行表征，分析轴向成分梯度、相变温度与磁化行为。
AI.result: 铸锭含拉长晶粒和主要源于Mn、Ga再分配的轴向成分梯度，Ni分布较均匀；马氏体和预马氏体相变温度随Mn含量增加而升高。Mn为20.5–22.0 at.%（e/a<7.40）的样品在10–400 K未检测到相变，而Mn≥22.1 at.%（e/a≥7.46）的样品均出现两种相变，提示存在电子浓度阈值。饱和磁化强度随Mn含量增至25.8 at.%而升高，10 K达96.9 A·m²/kg，300 K达71.2 A·m²/kg；生长后退火提高相变温度并改变低场磁响应。
AI.conclusion: 成分梯度寡晶是研究同一加工历史下Ni-Mn-Ga成分-结构-磁性能关系的有效平台，并揭示了电子浓度对相变出现的可能阈值效应。

title: Optimal Search Strategies under Finite Resource Constraints: The Role of Environmental Memory and Directional Information in Informed and Blind Protocols
summary: Improving the efficiency of a stochastic search often requires to provide the searching agent with resources that modify its dynamics and help it explore space more quickly. Although such resources are often assumed to be unlimited and treated as a cost to mitigate, many realistic search processes operate under a finite resource budget, e.g. in processes with environmental memory in which the searcher deposits long-lasting cues along its path that it can interact with at later times to guide its further search. Here, we address the question of how to allocate a limited budget to maximize search efficiency by investigating a one-dimensional diffusing agent whose access to resources is constrained. We consider three resource models, namely an external force applied by an external controller to pull the searcher towards the target, directional flags deposited by the searcher along its path that redirect its motion towards the target, and self-generated chemorepulsive cues that act as a force field. For all these models, we find that resource usage should be concentrated in narrow regions of space when information about the searcher's current and past positions is available. In contrast, in blind strategies where a predefined time protocol is followed, resources should be used at a steady rate to ensure it to be used at most of its capacity by the time it reaches the target. We further show that blind strategies in non-Markovian processes with environmental memory are significantly less efficient due to the inherent fluctuations in the locations of deposited cues.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在有限资源预算下如何分配资源以最大化随机搜索效率，通过一维扩散搜索者在三种资源模型（外力牵引、方向旗标、自生成化学排斥场）中的表现，发现：当掌握搜索者当前位置与历史信息时资源应集中于狭窄空间区域；而在盲策略（预设时间协议）下资源应以稳定速率使用。同时证明在具有环境记忆的非马尔可夫过程中，盲策略因沉积线索位置的固有波动而显著低效。
AI.motivation: 许多随机搜索过程实际运行在有限资源预算下（如具有环境记忆、搜索者沿路径沉积持久线索的搜索），而以往研究常假设资源无限或仅将其视为需削减的成本。因此作者希望回答：如何分配有限预算才能最大化搜索效率。
AI.method: 构建一维扩散搜索者在资源获取受限条件下的理论模型，比较三种资源模型：(1) 外部控制器施加外力将搜索者拉向目标；(2) 搜索者沿途沉积的方向旗标重新定向其运动；(3) 自生成的化学排斥线索作为力场。分别分析信息可用（当前位置与历史位置已知）与盲策略（预设时间协议）两种情形下的最优资源分配。
AI.result: 1）三种模型均表明：当掌握搜索者当前与过去位置信息时，资源应集中在狭窄的空间区域内使用；2）在盲策略中，资源应以稳定速率使用，以确保到达目标时资源接近其容量上限；3）在具有环境记忆的非马尔可夫过程中，由于沉积线索位置存在固有波动，盲策略效率显著降低。
AI.conclusion: 有限资源的最优分配高度依赖信息可得性：有位置信息时应空间局域化集中使用资源，无信息时应均匀稳定使用。环境记忆引入的线索位置波动会显著削弱盲策略的效率，凸显信息在资源受限搜索中的关键价值。

title: Graph-Recurrent Learning of Emergent Collective Dynamics
summary: Collective ordering in correlated electron systems emerges from microscopic dynamics, yet the evolution of observable textures need not admit a closed, memoryless description. We introduce a graph-recurrent neural network (GRNN) framework that learns such emergent dynamics directly from trajectories without specifying microscopic equations of motion. The framework integrates gated recurrent memory with graph message passing: local hidden states encode information beyond the instantaneous observables, while spatial coupling allows this information to propagate between sites. The observable and hidden fields evolve jointly through a shared local rule, providing a scalable representation of dynamics with spatial interactions and temporal memory. We demonstrate this framework on the emergent dynamics of charge-density-wave order in the semiclassical Holstein model, successfully reproducing temporal and spatial correlations and dynamical scaling during domain coarsening. By learning finite-time evolution directly, the GRNN offers a route to efficient, data-driven descriptions of collective dynamics with unresolved microscopic degrees of freedom.

AI.tldr: 该文提出图循环神经网络(GRNN)框架，直接从轨迹中学习关联电子系统中的集体序演化动力学，无需给定微观运动方程，并在Holstein模型电荷密度波畴粗化过程中成功复现时空关联与动力学标度。
AI.motivation: 集体序的可观测织构演化往往无法用闭合、无记忆的描述刻画，而微观自由度又难以解析，需要一种数据驱动、可扩展的方式来描述这类涌现动力学。
AI.method: 将门控循环记忆与图消息传递结合：局部隐状态编码瞬时可观测量之外的信息，空间耦合使信息在格点间传播；可观测场与隐场通过共享的局部规则联合演化，学习有限时间步的演化而非依赖微观方程。
AI.result: 在半经典Holstein模型的电荷密度波序涌现动力学上验证，成功复现了时间与空间关联，以及畴粗化过程中的动力学标度行为。
AI.conclusion: 直接学习有限时间演化可为含未解析微观自由度的集体动力学提供高效、数据驱动的描述途径。

title: Spin-Dependent Transport in One-Dimensional Mercury- and Silver-Mediated DNA Nanowires
summary: Metallo-DNA nanowires serve as a versatile, programmable scaffold for molecular-scale electronics. In this work, we demonstrate that periodic heavy-metal coordination fundamentally reshapes the electronic landscape of DNA, generating dispersive, metal-centered conduction bands rather than isolated localized states. Driven by enhanced inter-layer coupling, where second nearest-neighbor hopping plays a crucial role: the conduction bandwidth can approach 1 eV, more than double that of canonical DNA. These broad bands suggest enhanced robustness of transport against structural fluctuations. As a result of relativistic effects, in these quasi-one-dimensional materials, spin-orbit (SO) coupling enhances band dispersion and governs spin-dependent transport. We predict that although ligand hybridization reduces atomic SO splitting, the effective SO splitting in these nanowires is comparable to the next-nearest-neighbor hopping strength, which results in considerable spin mixing. We find that Hg2+-coordinated nanowire exhibit pronounced spin-flip conductance comparable to spin-conserving conductance across the LUMO manifold. This efficient spin conversion remains robust over extended molecular lengths and is accompanied by a set of highly delocalized unoccupied states with oscillating nodal structures, readily accessible under low-bias transport measurements. In contrast, the Ag+-coordinated nanowires exhibit weak spin-flip scattering that is more than an order of magnitude smaller than spin-preserving transport. This duality establishes the choice of coordination metal as a decisive parameter to govern metal-metal interaction, electron delocalization, and spin-dependent transport. Overall, our findings demonstrate how relativistic effects and quantum confinement intersect in these bio-templated, quasi-one-dimensional molecular conductors.

AI.tldr: 金属配位DNA纳米线中重原子周期配位产生金属中心色散导带，带宽可达~1 eV，并因强自旋轨道耦合出现显著自旋翻转输运，Hg²⁺与Ag⁺表现出鲜明对比的双重行为。
AI.motivation: 金属-DNA纳米线是分子电子学的可编程支架，但此前对其电子结构多限于孤立局域态的描述，缺乏对周期重金属配位如何重塑能带、带间耦合及相对论自旋轨道效应与量子限域如何交互的系统认识。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理/紧束缚类能带计算，构建周期性重金属（Hg²⁺、Ag⁺）配位的DNA纳米线模型，分析导带色散、次近邻跃迁、层间耦合、有效自旋轨道劈裂与自旋分辨电导（含自旋翻转与自旋守恒通道）。
AI.result: 导带带宽接近1 eV，超过常规DNA两倍，源于层间耦合增强且次近邻跃迁关键；有效SO劈裂与次近邻跃迁强度相当，导致强自旋混合。Hg²⁺纳米线在LUMO流形上自旋翻转电导与自旋守恒电导相当，且随分子长度延长仍稳健，伴有一组高度离域、节点振荡的空态；Ag²⁺（Ag⁺）纳米线自旋翻转散射弱，比自旋保持输运低一个数量级以上。
AI.conclusion: 配位金属的选择是调控金属-金属相互作用、电子离域与自旋依赖输运的决定性参数；相对论效应与量子限域在生物模板准一维分子导体中交汇，为自旋电子学功能化DNA器件提供设计原则（Hg²⁺用于高效自旋转换，Ag⁺用于弱自旋翻转）。

title: Sign-problem-free Bosonic Auxiliary Field Quantum Monte Carlo
summary: The sign problem poses a fundamental barrier to numerically exact quantum Monte Carlo simulations, severely hindering our understanding of quantum many-body physics across disciplines ranging from condensed matter to particle and nuclear physics. Geometrical frustration makes this barrier especially acute for interacting bosons. Here, we develop a bosonic auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo (BAFQMC) method and rigorously prove that time-reversal symmetry and reflection positivity each provide a general sufficient condition for sign-problem-free simulations. Crucially, under either criterion, BAFQMC evades the sign problem even on frustrated lattices where conventional world-line and stochastic-series-expansion methods fail. Benchmarking our approach on a two-flavor Bose-Hubbard model on the triangular lattice yields excellent quantitative agreement with finite-temperature exact diagonalization. By establishing unifying principles to solve the sign problem in BAFQMC, our work substantially expands the reach of unbiased, numerically exact simulations for frustrated bosonic matter.

AI.tldr: 本文提出玻色子辅助场量子蒙特卡洛（BAFQMC）方法，并严格证明时间反演对称性与反射正定性各自构成无符号问题的充分条件，从而在几何阻挫格子上实现对相互作用玻色子的无偏、数值精确模拟。
AI.motivation: 符号问题严重阻碍量子蒙特卡洛对量子多体物理的数值精确研究，而几何阻挫使相互作用玻色子的符号问题尤为尖锐，传统世界线与随机级数展开方法在此失效。
AI.method: 发展玻色子辅助场量子蒙特卡洛（BAFQMC）方法；严格证明时间反演对称性与反射正定性各自是可实现无符号问题的通用充分条件，并在三角晶格双味玻色-哈伯德模型上进行基准测试。
AI.result: 在任一判据下，BAFQMC 即使在传统方法失效的阻挫格子上也能规避符号问题；三角晶格双味玻色-哈伯德模型的基准结果与有限温精确对角化定量吻合良好。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了解决 BAFQMC 符号问题的统一原则，显著拓展了无偏、数值精确模拟在阻挫玻色子物质研究中的适用范围。

title: Automated generation and execution of large-scale semidefinite programs for variational two-electron reduced density matrix theory
summary: The variational two-electron reduced density matrix (v2RDM) method provides a wave-function-free approach to the description of strong electron correlation whose computational cost scales polynomially with the number of correlated orbitals. Here, we present an automated pipeline for the generation and execution of semidefinite programs (SDPs) associated with the v2RDM problem. Algebraic constraints encoding ensemble $N$-representability conditions are generated via the p$^\dagger$q second-quantized algebra package, and the p$^\dagger$q-generated expressions are automatically translated into a sparse-matrix representation that can be digested by an appropriate SDP solver. We have implemented a boundary-point SDP (BPSDP) solver in the libsdp package that can execute the v2RDM SDPs on either CPU or GPU hardware. We apply the code in several contexts. First, two-particle conditions are used to describe the 76-orbital model of the iron-molybdenum cofactor (FeMoco) of nitrogenase, the simulation of which requires roughly 25 hours of compute time on a single Nvidia H100 GPU. Second, the performance of high-order (four-particle positivity) conditions is evaluated on a challenging two-dimensional H$_{10}$ cluster problem. Lastly, new classes of positivity constraints for mixed fermion-boson systems are generated and applied within the context of ab initio cavity quantum electrodynamics simulations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个自动化流程，用于生成并求解变分双电子约化密度矩阵（v2RDM）的半定规划（SDP），并在GPU上高效执行。
AI.motivation: v2RDM 方法可无波函数地描述强电子关联、代价随轨道数多项式增长，但构造与求解对应的 SDP 繁琐且计算量大，缺乏自动化与硬件加速支持。
AI.method: 利用 p†q 二次量子化代数包自动生成编码集合 N-可表示性条件的代数约束，并自动翻译为稀疏矩阵形式供 SDP 求解器使用；在 libsdp 中实现边界点 SDP（BPSDP）求解器，支持 CPU 与 GPU。
AI.result: 用两粒子条件描述固氮酶 FeMoco 的 76 轨道模型，单块 Nvidia H100 GPU 约需 25 小时；在二维 H10 团簇上评估高阶（四粒子正性）条件性能；并生成混合费米子-玻色子体系的新类正性约束，应用于从头算腔 QED 模拟。
AI.conclusion: 该自动化 + GPU 加速的 v2RDM-SDP 流程使大规模强关联问题及新约束（高阶正性、费米子-玻色子）的实际应用成为可能。

title: QuDPy-FDGF: A Python-Based Tool for Computing Ultrafast Nonlinear Optical Responses Using Frequency Domain Green's Functions
summary:
We present QuDPy-FDGF, an open-source Python framework that evaluates Liouville-space pathways as hybrid chains of time propagators and frequency-domain Green's functions. Frequency-resolved intervals are computed directly through shifted linear systems, without time propagation followed by a Fourier transform, while other intervals may remain in the time domain. A model-agnostic block interface separates the physical model from pathway construction, numerical propagation, and detection. The released implementation provides an explicit dense Liouville-space backend for reference calculations and a sector-resolved sparse backend using matrix-free generator actions, Krylov time propagation, and generalized minimal residual (GMRES) resolvent solves. Its observable layer reuses propagated pathway responses to evaluate operator expectation values, action-detected readout interactions, instantaneous jump rates, and integrated mean jump counts.
  The framework is assessed on an analytically solvable open two-level system and on two examples of increasing complexity: the complete third-order rephasing response, with its eight sequences, of a thermally initialized anisotropic Heisenberg (XXZ) spin chain with unequal excitation sectors, and two coupled dissipative anharmonic modes whose spectra depend on the detected observable, with the fifth-order double-quantum response of their closed limit. The calculations reproduce the analytical two-level response, check the matrix-free sparse evaluation against the dense assembly of the generator, and recover the harmonic-limit cancellation of the fifth-order signal when the required three-excitation manifold is retained. QuDPy-FDGF therefore provides a unified framework for pathway- and observable-resolved nonlinear spectroscopy in finite or truncated Hilbert spaces with unitary or Markovian Gorini--Kossakowski--Sudarshan--Lindblad (GKSL) dynamics.

AI.tldr: QuDPy-FDGF is an open-source Python framework that evaluates Liouville-space response pathways as hybrid chains of time propagators and frequency-domain Green's functions, enabling pathway- and observable-resolved nonlinear spectroscopy with unitary or Markovian GKSL dynamics.
AI.motivation: Existing pathway-based spectroscopy tools typically compute frequency-resolved intervals only after full time propagation followed by Fourier transform, and often couple the physical model tightly to pathway construction and numerics. A unified, model-agnostic, open-source framework is needed that can mix time-domain and frequency-domain intervals, support open-system (GKSL) dynamics, and provide observable-resolved readouts in finite or truncated Hilbert spaces.
AI.method: The framework represents Liouville-space pathways as hybrid chains mixing time propagators and frequency-domain Green's functions; frequency-resolved intervals are computed directly via shifted linear systems (avoiding FFT). A model-agnostic block interface decouples the physical model from pathway construction, propagation, and detection. It offers two backends: an explicit dense Liouville-space backend for reference calculations, and a sector-resolved sparse backend using matrix-free generator actions, Krylov time propagation, and GMRES resolvent solves. An observable layer reuses propagated pathway responses to compute operator expectation values, action-detected readout interactions, instantaneous jump rates, and integrated mean jump counts.
AI.result: Validated on an analytically solvable open two-level system (reproducing analytical response), then on two increasingly complex examples: the full third-order rephasing response with eight sequences of a thermally initialized anisotropic XXZ Heisenberg spin chain with unequal excitation sectors, and two coupled dissipative anharmonic modes with observable-dependent spectra including the fifth-order double-quantum response in the closed limit. The sparse matrix-free evaluation agrees with dense generator assembly, and the harmonic-limit cancellation of the fifth-order signal is recovered when the required three-excitation manifold is retained.
AI.conclusion: QuDPy-FDGF provides a unified, open-source framework for pathway- and observable-resolved nonlinear spectroscopy in finite or truncated Hilbert spaces under unitary or Markovian GKSL dynamics, combining hybrid time/frequency-domain evaluation with scalable sparse backends.

title: Synthetic Stochastic Time Series from Generative Models
comment: 17 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables; Supporting Information (10 pages) included
summary: Obtaining statistically converged time-series data represents a fundamental challenge in computational chemistry, where sampling is constrained by the prohibitive computational cost of high-fidelity simulations. The accuracy attainable from a finite simulation budget is governed by the standard-error scaling $1/\sqrt{n}$, rendering exhaustive sampling challenging for systems of realistic complexity. Here we show that generative models trained on high-quality stochastic trajectories can reproduce key statistical properties of the underlying process and generate additional synthetic trajectories at substantially lower computational cost, thereby enhancing the sampling accessible from a finite set of simulations. We present a systematic comparison of four generative architectures across two complementary data sources: an analytically tractable Ornstein-Uhlenbeck reference and donor-acceptor energy-gap trajectories from all-atom molecular dynamics simulations. Among the four architectures tested, the denoising diffusion probabilistic model reproduces the target statistics most consistently, across both data sources and across the range of correlation times examined, and generates far faster than the sequential Transformer. Specifically, for the energy-gap trajectories, augmentation from 0.1 ns of training data yields statistical estimates comparable in accuracy to those obtained from 0.25-0.50 ns of direct MD sampling. We further show that the benefit of synthetic augmentation is bounded by the information contained in the training data, producing a quality floor determined by both the training data and the generative model. Our findings establish diffusion-based generative models as an effective route to data-driven augmentation of stochastic time series in computational chemistry.

AI.tldr: 该研究表明，在高保真模拟预算有限的情况下，可用高质量随机轨迹训练生成模型，以低成本合成额外轨迹来增强统计采样；在四种生成架构中，去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）表现最稳定、生成最快。
AI.motivation: 计算化学中高保真模拟成本高昂，统计收敛受限于 $1/\sqrt{n}$ 的标准误标度，有限预算下难以对真实复杂体系进行充分采样。
AI.method: 系统比较四种生成架构，在两个数据源上测试：可解析的 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 参考过程，以及全原子分子动力学得到的供体-受体能隙轨迹；评测其复现统计性质的能力、相关时间范围与生成速度。
AI.result: DDPM 在两种数据源及所考察的相关时间范围内最一致地复现目标统计量，且生成速度远快于自回归 Transformer；对能隙轨迹，用 0.1 ns 训练数据增强可达到相当于 0.25–0.50 ns 直接 MD 采样的统计精度。
AI.conclusion: 合成增强的收益受训练数据所含信息量限制，存在由训练数据与生成模型共同决定的质量下限；基于扩散的生成模型是计算化学中数据驱动时序增强的有效途径。

title: Concentration-Dependent Speciation in ZnCl2 Electrolyte Solutions: Transferability of Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials and Speciation Sensitivity of EXAFS
summary: Predicting speciation in concentrated electrolytes requires accurate ion interactions and adequate sampling of slowly interconverting coordination environments. We combine Zn K-edge extended X-ray absorption fine structure (EXAFS) measurements with long-timescale molecular dynamics (MD) using machine-learning interatomic potentials to study aqueous ZnCl2 from dilute conditions to 30 m. We train revPBE-based DeepMD models with D3 corrections included or excluded for Zn-containing pairs and compare them with DPMD-SCAN, classical MD (CMD), and MACE-MATPES-r2SCAN. EXAFS calculations are benchmarked against hydrated and chloride-coordinated Zn reference complexes, then applied to MD ensembles alongside Zn-Cl coordination free-energy analysis. Increasing concentration reduces octahedral coordination, replaces water with chloride, and promotes chloride-bridged association. All three DeepMD models yield similar EXAFS at 3 m, but DPMD-SCAN shows greater transferability across concentrations, reproducing measured spectral trends, key features of mixed ZnCl2/LiCl spectra, and octahedral fractions consistent with other studies. DFT treatment strongly affects coordination free energies and aggregation; excluding Zn-related D3 corrections does not systematically improve EXAFS agreement. CMD shows larger spectral discrepancies and less consistent coordination trends. MACE-MATPES-r2SCAN improves upon CMD and yields spectra comparable to DPMD-SCAN, which provides more consistent agreement and greater computational efficiency. Neighbor-resolved analysis shows that distance disorder and scattering-path interference can produce similar EXAFS signatures for distinct coordination ensembles, highlighting the need for rigorous sampling and ensemble-averaged spectra to distinguish isolated from chloride-bridged Zn species.

AI.tldr: 本文结合Zn K边EXAFS实验与基于机器学习势的长时间尺度分子动力学，研究从稀溶液到30 m的ZnCl2水溶液中的离子配位与缔合，并系统比较多种势函数（DPMD-revPBE±D3、DPMD-SCAN、经典MD、MACE-MATPES-r2SCAN）。
AI.motivation: 准确预测浓电解质中的物种形态（speciation）既需要可靠的离子相互作用描述，又需要对缓慢互变的配位环境进行充分采样；而不同DFT处理（泛函、色散校正）对配位自由能与聚集行为的影响尚不清楚，缺乏系统基准。
AI.method: 1) 用EXAFS计算先在水合与氯配位Zn参考络合物上做基准，再应用于MD系综；2) 训练revPBE基DeepMD模型（含/不含Zn相关对的D3校正），与DPMD-SCAN、经典MD及MACE-MATPES-r2SCAN比较；3) 结合Zn–Cl配位自由能分析与按邻居分辨的分析。
AI.result: 随浓度升高，八面体配位减少、水被氯取代、氯桥缔合增强。3 m下三种DeepMD模型EXAFS相近，但DPMD-SCAN跨浓度可迁移性最佳：再现谱学趋势、ZnCl2/LiCl混合谱关键特征，八面体分数与其他研究一致。排除Zn相关D3校正并未系统性改善EXAFS一致性；CMD谱偏差较大、配位趋势不稳；MACE-MATPES-r2SCAN优于CMD，谱与DPMD-SCAN相当但后者计算效率更高。
AI.conclusion: DFT处理显著影响配位自由能与聚集行为。距离无序与散射路径干涉可让不同配位系综产生相似的EXAFS信号，因此必须依靠严格采样与系综平均谱来区分孤立与氯桥Zn物种。DPMD-SCAN在准确性与效率上综合最优。

title: Unconstrained learning of equivariant atomistic properties
summary: Machine-learned interatomic potentials based on graph neural networks (GNNs) have made first-principles accuracy routine for the potential energy surface (PES). Their backbones, often O(3)-equivariant by design, are increasingly used to learn other atomistic properties. Many of these are of high angular order or pseudotensorial character, defined per atom, or expanded on large atom-centered basis sets. Such targets strain equivariant GNNs, whose tensor products grow steeply in cost with angular order and can fail to represent the target if truncated, forcing difficult trade-offs between hyperparameters. Unconstrained models like the Point-Edge Transformer (PET) instead replace explicit O(3) algebra with edge-to-edge attention and learn equivariance from data, so that the same backbone can in principle learn any equivariant property. We demonstrate how to use PET to learn molecular dipoles and polarizabilities, NMR chemical shielding tensors, and auxiliary-basis expansions of the electron density. Increasing the backbone size systematically improves both accuracy and equivariance error, and targeted architectural and training choices reduce the symmetry breaking further. PET matches or improves on the released reference models at lower inference cost and, compared with equivariant models, a smaller memory footprint. The predictions give accurate IR and Raman spectra and isotropic shieldings; the predicted densities accelerate self-consistent field calculations and give one-shot ground-state properties, and pretrained density models transfer to higher levels of theory by fine-tuning on little data. The impact of approximate equivariance is small for most observables, further validating this approach to train fast, accurate, and useful surrogate models for properties beyond the PES.

AI.tldr: 提出用非约束的 Point-Edge Transformer (PET) 学习分子偶极、极化率、NMR 化学屏蔽张量及电子密度等 PES 之外的原子性质，通过与等变模型相当的精度、更低的推理成本和小得多的显存，验证"从数据学习等变性"路线的可行性与通用性。
AI.motivation: O(3) 等变 GNN 虽能达到第一性原理精度，但其张量积计算随角动量阶数急剧增长；对高阶角向、伪张量、逐原子定义或大基组展开的目标，截断会丧失表达能力，超参折衷困难。因此需要一种能灵活学习任意等变性质的通用骨干。
AI.method: 采用 PET 这一无约束架构，以边到边注意力替代显式 O(3) 代数，从数据中学习等变性；将其迁移到偶极、极化率、NMR 屏蔽张量、辅助基组电子密度展开等多类目标，并通过增大骨干、针对性架构与训练设计降低对称性破缺。
AI.result: 在更低推理成本与小显存下达到或优于官方参考模型；放大约束骨干可同步改善精度与等变误差；预测给出准确的 IR/Raman 谱与各向同性屏蔽；预测密度可加速 SCF 并提供一次性基态性质；预训练密度模型经少量微调可迁移到更高理论层级；近似等变对多数观测量影响很小。
AI.conclusion: 近似等变对大多数可观测量影响可忽略，非约束的 PET 可作为 PES 之外快速、准确、实用的替代模型，验证了以数据学习等变性的通用路線。

title: Precise Determination of Electric Dipole Polarizabilities of Sr Clock States Using Linear-Response and Equation-of-Motion Relativistic Coupled-Cluster Methods
summary: We present accurate values of the electric dipole polarizabilities ($α$) of the ground and excited states of Sr using four-component relativistic coupled-cluster (RCC) theory within the linear-response (LR) and equation-of-motion (EOM) frameworks. We first investigated accuracy of the ground-state polarizability using the LR-RCC method in both spherical and Cartesian coordinate representations. Upon obtaining consistent results for the ground state, we determine the polarizabilities of the excited states using the EOM-RCC method within the finite-field approach. The uncertainties in our results are assessed by examining the completeness of the basis set, higher-order relativistic corrections, and contributions from higher-level excitation configurations beyond the truncation in our RCC method. We also discuss various procedures for extrapolating contributions to the complete basis set limit and examine their respective limitations. Our calculated ground-state polarizability is found to be inconsistent with the latest atomic calculation, but agrees with other calculations and experimental value. Using the differential $α$ value from the EOM-RCC method, we estimate the fractional black-body-radiation-induced frequency shift of the Sr $^{1}$S$_{0}$$\rightarrow$$^{3}$P$_{0}$ clock transition to be $-5.40\times10^{-15}$.

AI.tldr: 本文用四分量相对论耦合簇(LR-RCC与EOM-RCC)方法计算了Sr基态与激发态的电偶极极化率α，并给出Sr ¹S₀→³P₀钟跃迁的黑体辐射频移分数值为−5.40×10⁻¹⁵。
AI.motivation: 精确的原子极化率对评估锶光钟的黑体辐射频移至关重要，而现有文献中Sr基态极化率的计算结果存在分歧，需用高精度相对论方法加以检验与澄清。
AI.method: 在球坐标与笛卡尔坐标两种表象下用线性响应四分量RCC(LR-RCC)计算基态极化率，验证一致性后，用EOM-RCC结合有限场法求激发态极化率；通过基组完备性、高阶相对论修正及超出截断的高阶激发组态贡献评估不确定度，并讨论外推至完备基组极限的方法及其局限。
AI.result: 基态极化率与最新的某原子计算结果不一致，但与其他计算及实验值吻合；由EOM-RCC得到的差分α估算出Sr ¹S₀→³P₀钟跃迁的黑体辐射诱导频移分数为−5.40×10⁻¹⁵。
AI.conclusion: 四分量相对论耦合簇方法可为Sr提供可靠的极化率数据，并支撑对光钟黑体辐射频移的精密评估。

title: Multireference Polarizable Embedding for Core-Level Spectroscopy in Aqueous Solution: XPS and XAS of Glycine
summary: Core-level spectra in solution are governed by the interplay of core-hole relaxation, electron correlation, specific solute--solvent interactions, and environmental polarization. We report the first application of RASSCF--RASPT2 combined with the fluctuating-charges polarizable embedding to X-ray photoelectron (XPS) and X-ray absorption (XAS) spectroscopy in aqueous solution. The protocol couples a multireference treatment of core-ionized and core-excited states with molecular-dynamics sampling, and is assessed for the carbon and nitrogen K-edges of glycine in the gas phase and in water. The calculated spectra are compared with experiment and with fixed-charges electrostatic embedding. Gas-phase ionization and absorption features are accurately reproduced. In solution, configurational averaging captures inhomogeneous broadening, while XPS peak positions, relative intensities, and widths depend strongly on the solvent parametrization. The best-performing polarizable model improves the spectral profile, although aqueous ionization energies remain overestimated. For XAS, the carbon K-edge is reproduced close to the experimental energy scale, whereas the nitrogen K-edge line shape is recovered after rigid alignment. These results support multireference polarizable embedding as a promising framework for core-level spectroscopy in solution.

AI.tldr: 首次将RASSCF–RASPT2与涨落电荷可极化嵌入结合，用于水溶液中甘氨酸K边XPS/XAS的计算。
AI.motivation: 溶液中的芯能级谱由芯空穴弛豫、电子相关、溶质–溶剂特异相互作用与环境极化共同决定，需要能同时处理多参考相关与可极化环境的计算框架。
AI.method: 将RASSCF–RASPT2多参考方法处理芯电离与芯激发态，与涨落电荷可极化嵌入耦合，并结合分子动力学构型采样；对气相和水相中甘氨酸的C、N K边XPS与XAS进行计算，与实验及固定电荷静电嵌入对比。
AI.result: 气相电离与吸收特征被准确再现；溶液中构型平均可捕捉非均匀展宽，XPS峰位、相对强度与线宽强烈依赖溶剂参数化，最佳可极化模型改善谱型但水相电离能仍被高估；XAS中碳K边接近实验能量尺度，氮K边线型经刚性对齐后可复现。
AI.conclusion: 多参考可极化嵌入是研究溶液芯能级谱的有前景框架，但溶剂参数化与绝对电离能的描述仍需改进。

title: Unifying Time-Independent and Time-Dependent Franck--Condon Pictures in Quantum Mechanochemistry via the Linear Coupling Approximation
summary:
Quantum chemistry has achieved impressive results in modeling and interpreting mechanochemical transformations at the molecular level. An essential question, the time profile of force application, has
  however attracted less attention. Here, the Franck--Condon theory
  of quantum mechanochemistry, previously formulated for the
  sudden-force limit, is generalized to arbitrary time-dependent
  force profiles using the linear-coupling approximation. Solving the
  driven harmonic oscillator yields a closed-form, time-dependent
  effective Huang--Rhys factor: a natural measure of vibrational excitations upon force application. It is governed by the Fourier transform of
  the force derivative and recovers the sudden- and fixed-force limits. At the conceptual level, this linear
  coupling picture links mechanochemistry to vibronic spectroscopy and Marcus electron
  theory. For a shock-front force ramp, vibrational excitation is
  shown to be suppressed in frequency, only
  low-frequency modes being excited under realistic laser-shock-peening
  conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文将先前仅适用于"突变力"极限的量子力学化学Franck–Condon理论推广到任意时间依赖的力轮廓，基于线性耦合近似求解受驱谐振子，给出闭式含时有效Huang–Rhys因子。
AI.motivation: 量子化学已在分子尺度上出色地建模和解释机械化学转变，但一个关键问题——施力的时间轮廓（力如何随时间加载）——关注较少。已有理论多局限于突变力极限。
AI.method: 采用线性耦合近似推广Franck–Condon量子机械化学理论；通过求解受驱谐振子，得到闭式含时的有效Huang–Rhys因子，该因子由力导数的傅里叶变换决定，可回到突变力与固定力两种极限。
AI.result: 有效Huang–Rhys因子作为施力时振动激发的自然度量，其闭式表达式能重现突变力和固定力极限；对于冲击波前沿式的力斜坡，振动激发在高频被抑制，仅在真实激光冲击喷丸条件下激发低频模式。
AI.conclusion: 线性耦合图像在概念上把机械化学与振动光谱学及Marcus电子理论联系起来，并揭示了施力时间尺度对振动激发频率选择性的调控作用。

title: Stiff source terms inside ADER-DG method
summary: ADER-DG numerical method with the LST-DG predictor, when used to solve hyperbolic equations with stiff source terms, exhibits properties characteristic of IMEX computational schemes. With increasing stiffness, characterized by the parameter $z = ν{Δt}^{n} < 0$, the maximum of the Courant number $\mathrm{CFL}_{\rm max}$ of the ADER-DG numerical method increases. In the region of strong stiffness $|z| \gg 1$, a linear increase in the Courant number $\mathrm{CFL}_{\rm max}(z) \sim |z|$ occurs. In the region of small source terms $|z| \ll 1$, the results $\mathrm{CFL}_{\rm max}(z)$ transform into known results for the problem $\mathrm{CFL}_{\rm max}(0)$ without source terms. In the transition region $|z| \sim 1$, a range of insignificant decrease in the Courant number $\mathrm{CFL}_{\rm max}(z)$ is discovered. In the linear case, instability is violated precisely when one of the matrix eigenvalues reaches $λ= -1$, regardless of the phase $θ$ of the numerical solution. A rigorous stability theory of the ADER-DG numerical method for stiff problems for arbitrary degree $N$ of basis polynomials is constructed. The stability condition is simplified to solving a polynomial equation for the Courant number $\mathrm{CFL}$. Highly accurate dependencies of the Courant number $\mathrm{CFL}_{\rm max}(N, z)$ of the ADER-DG method on the parameter $z$ are obtained. A rigorous direct proof of the approximation of the ADER-DG method is presented. Approximation orders $p = N+1$ for arbitrary degrees $N$ are rigorously derived. A set of numerical experiments is carried out to apply the ADER-DG method to solving both a linear advection-reaction equation and the system of Euler equations for a two-component reacting medium. The results obtained in these calculations confirm the theoretical results well.

AI.tldr: 本文为采用 LST-DG 预测子的 ADER-DG 数值方法建立了针对刚性源项问题的严格稳定性理论，给出任意基多项式阶数 N 下的稳定性条件与最大 Courant 数 CFL_max(N,z) 的高精度依赖关系，并严格证明 p=N+1 阶逼近，数值实验验证了理论。
AI.motivation: ADER-DG 结合 LST-DG 预测子求解含刚性源项的双曲方程时表现出 IMEX 类特性：随刚度 |z| 增大，最大 Courant 数随之增大，但缺乏严格的稳定性分析框架。作者希望填补这一理论空白，给出可精确计算 CFL 稳定性界限的方法。
AI.method: 构建任意阶 N 下 ADER-DG 方法求解刚性问题的严格稳定性理论；将稳定性条件化简为关于 Courant 数 CFL 的多项式方程求解；在过渡区分析 CFL_max(z) 的行为；并给出方法的严格逼近性直接证明。最后开展线性对流-反应方程与双组分反应介质 Euler 方程组的数值实验。
AI.result: 强刚性区 |z|≫1 时 CFL_max(z)∼|z| 线性增长；小源项区 |z|≪1 时退化到无源项的已知结果 CFL_max(0)；过渡区 |z|∼1 出现 CFL 轻微下降区间。线性情形下失稳恰在某矩阵特征值达到 λ=-1 时发生，与数值解的相位 θ 无关。获得 CFL_max(N,z) 的高精度依赖关系；数值实验结果与理论吻合良好。
AI.conclusion: 作者为 ADER-DG+LST-DG 预测子的刚性问题提供了完整、严格的稳定性与逼近理论，可精确预测任意阶数下的最大 Courant 数，并解释了其随刚度变化的非单调规律；数值实验证实理论正确性，为刚性双曲问题的稳定时间步选择提供了理论依据。

title: Extended-regularized lattice Boltzmann method
summary: Regularized lattice Boltzmann methods improve numerical stability by projecting the nonequilibrium distribution onto its hydrodynamic second-order Hermite sector and filtering the remaining kinetic modes. We introduce a separate relaxation time for the complete complementary kinetic subspace. The resulting extended-regularized lattice Boltzmann method (E-RLBM) interpolates continuously between the Bhatnagar-Gross-Krook and regularized collision operators while retaining a two-rate implementation. A Chapman-Enskog expansion shows that the isothermal Navier-Stokes equations are recovered with kinematic viscosity $ν=c_s^2(τ-Δt/2)$, independently of the kinetic relaxation time $τ_{\rm nh}$, whereas $τ_{\rm nh}$ changes higher-order truncation errors. For linear transverse shear, its first effect is a fourth-derivative term whose coefficient depends on the direction of propagation relative to the lattice. This fourth-order coefficient is affine in $τ_{\rm nh}$. For linear shear on D2Q9 and $τ_{\rm nh}$ between $τ$ and $Δt$, it lies between the corresponding BGK and RLBM values in every propagation direction. Stability maps for the decaying Taylor-Green vortex and flow past a rectangular obstacle show that an appropriate kinetic relaxation substantially enlarges the stable parameter domain. In a Taylor-Green convergence test with consistent initialization, all three operators converge at second order, and their error differences follow the hyperviscous coefficient for diagonal shear waves: the E-RLBM error is about 6% above the BGK error and about 40% below the RLBM error; in a double shear layer at Re = 80000, the E-RLBM follows the RLBM convergence curve. The proposed collision operator therefore provides a low-cost means of controlling nonhydrodynamic modes without introducing a full multiple-relaxation-time basis.

AI.tldr: 提出扩展正则化格子Boltzmann方法(E-RLBM)，为完整动力学子空间引入独立弛豫时间，可在BGK与RLBM之间连续插值，仅需双速率实现即可调控非流体动力学模态并显著扩大稳定参数域。
AI.motivation: RLBM通过把非平衡分布投影到二阶Hermite流体动力学扇区并滤除其余动理学模态来提升稳定性，但完全滤除这些模态可能过度耗散；而完整MRT基成本较高。作者希望以低成本方式对非流体模态实现可调控制。
AI.method: 为完整互补动理学子空间单独设置弛豫时间τ_nh，构造双速率碰撞算子，使E-RLBM在BGK与正则化碰撞算子之间连续过渡。通过Chapman-Enskog展开推导输运方程，并对线性横向剪切做高阶截断误差分析，考察τ_nh对四阶导数（类超粘性）项系数的影响及方向依赖性。
AI.result: Chapman-Enskog展开表明等温Navier-Stokes方程被正确恢复，运动粘度ν=c_s²(τ−Δt/2)与τ_nh无关，τ_nh只改变高阶截断误差。线性剪切下首个效应为四阶导数项，其系数对τ_nh仿射且在传播方向上不同；D2Q9上τ_nh∈[τ,Δt]时其值介于BGK与RLBM之间。衰减Taylor-Green涡与矩形障碍绕流的稳定域图显示合适τ_nh可大幅扩大稳定参数范围。Taylor-Green收敛测试中三者均为二阶，E-RLBM误差比BGK高约6%、比RLBM低约40%；Re=80000双剪切层中E-RLBM与RLBM收敛曲线接近。
AI.conclusion: E-RLBM以双速率、低计算成本的结构实现了非流体动力学模态的可控调节，在不引入完整MRT基的情况下兼顾稳定性与精度，为稳定化碰撞算子的设计提供了连续可调的中间方案。

title: Influence of nanoparticle shapes in nanofluid film boiling on vertical cylinders: A numerical study
comment: Published in the International Journal of Thermofluids (2024)
summary: This research explores how nanoparticle shapes affect the thermal behavior of nanofluid film boiling along a vertical cylinder, using a Continuous-Species-Transfer method within a Computational Multi-Fluid Dynamics framework. The behavior of nanoparticles in both liquid and vapor phases is modeled, accounting for Brownian motion and thermophoresis. A comprehensive two-dimensional axisymmetric analysis is conducted to investigate the effects of various Al2O3 nanoparticle shapes, including spheres, bricks, blades, cylinders, and platelets, on boiling heat transfer. The results demonstrate that nanoparticle shape has a minimal impact on deposition dynamics but significantly affects kinematic viscosity, particularly for platelet-shaped nanoparticles. Blade-shaped nanoparticles provide substantial enhancement of thermal transport, as indicated by pronounced temperature gradients and increased thermal conductivity. These nanoparticles also improve the Nusselt number, suggesting enhanced boiling heat transfer efficiency. This improvement is particularly significant at higher nanoparticle concentrations, although the relationship is not strictly linear. Future work will explore different nanoparticle materials, boiling scenarios, and experimental validation.

AI.tldr: 采用CST-CMFD方法研究Al2O3纳米颗粒形状对竖直圆柱纳米流体膜沸腾传热的影响，发现板状颗粒显著影响运动黏度，刀片状颗粒最能增强传热与Nu数。
AI.motivation: 探究不同形状纳米颗粒对纳米流体在竖直圆柱表面膜沸腾热行为的影响，弥补颗粒形状因素在沸腾传热研究中关注不足的问题。
AI.method: 在计算多流体动力学框架下引入连续物种传递(CST)方法，建立二维轴对称模型，同时考虑液相与气相中纳米颗粒行为及布朗运动、热泳效应；对比球形、砖形、刀片形、圆柱形和片状五种Al2O3颗粒形状。
AI.result: 颗粒形状对沉积动力学影响很小，但显著影响运动黏度（片状颗粒尤甚）；刀片状颗粒使温度梯度更陡、导热系数提高，明显增强热输运并提升努塞尔数，高浓度下效果更突出，但并非严格线性关系。
AI.conclusion: 纳米颗粒形状是调控膜沸腾传热性能的重要参数，刀片状Al2O3颗粒具有最佳传热强化潜力；未来将拓展颗粒材料、沸腾工况并开展实验验证。
